Vintage Estate Tobacco Pipes
Briar Smoking Pipe Collection
9 Items, Mid to Late 20th Century
This estate lot includes nine vintage briar tobacco smoking pipes presenting a diverse selection of classic English and American shapes, finishes, and makers. Description:
Add a unique piece of history to your space with this assortment of vintage teal glass insulators, once used to support overhead power lines. Each insulator in this set showcases distinct shapes, textures, and slightly different shades of teal and green, creating a captivating collection for display. Visible wear and patina reflect their authentic utility and age, enhancing their nostalgic character and appeal. One notable feature is a wooden base with a descriptive label, indicating these insulators were part of the Colorado Springs - Cripple Creek Toll Line, dated from 1910 to 1978. This historical detail adds an extra layer of interest, making the set especially attractive for collectors and history enthusiasts. Ideal for use as decorative accents on shelves, mantels, or desks, these insulators offer a charming way to incorporate industrial heritage into your home or office decor. This item is in used vintage condition and displays signs of wear consistent with age and previous use

Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites

description:
Scott's Mineral Box Industries
Vintage Rocks and Minerals Specimen Collection Set
24 Labeled Specimens with Display Box
A classic mid-century educational geology collection produced by Scott's Mineral Box Industries of Custer, South Dakota. Dating to the 1950s to 1960s, these boxed study sets were distributed to rockhounds, students, and tourists visiting the Black Hills. Each natural geological specimen is mounted and identified on a printed compartmentalized tray, illustrating key ore, mineral, and rock classifications from North American deposits.
Includes 24 individually labeled specimens including Gold Ore, Copper Ore, Rose Quartz, Muscovite, Uranium Ore, and Petrified Wood
Accompanied by an additional natural clear quartz crystal point
Housed in the original faux-tooled leatherette textured cardboard box with matching lid
Measures approximately 8.6 inches long by 5.6 inches wide by 1 inch deep
Condition:
Box lid and base remain structurally sound with light corner and edge wear consistent with age. Printed tray is clean and legible with all 24 labeled specimens intact and firmly attached. Loose quartz crystal point is complete with natural terminations and surface inclusions.

Belleek
Porcelain Desk Pen Stand with Pen
Circa 1990s, Gilt Accents and Nautical Motif
Crafted by Belleek Pottery in County Fermanagh, Ireland, this glazed porcelain desk stand showcases the maker's renowned craftsmanship in fine ceramic wares. The oval base features low-relief nautical motifs including an embossed scallop shell, starfish, and textured rope border, highlighted by an interior gold-gilt accent line. Complete with an adjustable gold-tone ball-and-socket swivel mount and matching desk pen, it represents both functional executive utility and classic decorative styling.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.

Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

description:
Large Rock Mineral Collection Bundle Good and Beautiful Educational Box
This large rock and mineral collection bundle includes the Good and Beautiful branded educational specimen box with 9 labeled compartments featuring igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic, and mineral samples such as mica, quartz, and pyrite. Also included is a French-labeled display case with 24 compartments containing various tumbled and raw stones like Microcline, Labradorite, Cornaline, Jaspe, Amazonite, Rhodonite, Calcite, Dolomie, Gabbro, and Apatite in a bamboo-framed glass-covered box. Additionally, there is a large loose assortment of approximately 40+ raw and polished stones and minerals, including lava rock, amethyst cluster, turquoise-colored stone, tiger's eye, petrified wood, onyx/calcite slab, rutilated quartz, and various jaspers and agates. Items show typical used and handled condition consistent with an educational or hobbyist rock collection. Specimens vary in size from small chips to palm-sized pieces. This collection is suitable for geology enthusiasts, collectors, or educational purposes.

title: Vintage Glass Insulator 3 Piece Lot Hemingray O.V.G. Co Aqua Green Damaged
description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

Description:
Add a touch of industrial charm to your collection with this pair of vintage clear glass insulators. These sturdy pieces, formerly used on power or telegraph lines, feature thick, quality glass construction with a utilitarian round design. The Hemingray brand signature is visible, showcasing American-made craftsmanship that collectors appreciate. Both insulators display slightly different designs and details, including bases one is smooth, while the other has pronounced dimples. Aged patina and minor marks highlight their authentic history and prior field use, offering unique character to each item. These insulators are perfect for display in home decor as conversation pieces or for creative upcycling projects. Their robust glass structure and timeless look make them suitable for collectors, decorators, or anyone interested in industrial relics. Please note: Both items show visible wear and surface residue consistent with age and use. No major cracks or chips are evident from inspection. Enjoy these pieces as decorative accents or add them to your vintage glassware collection

description:
Virginia Mineral & Rock Collection
20 Mounted Geological Specimens with Identification Chart
From the Collection of Rudolph J. Bland, Jr.
Authentic boxed collection of 20 mineral and rock specimens representing various counties across the Commonwealth of Virginia. Assembled from the collection of noted Virginia mineralogist Rudolph J. Bland, Jr., this educational reference set features an indexed label on the interior lid pairing each numbered specimen with its mineral type and county locality. Also includes a group of accompanying loose stones, a projectile point, and a seashell.
Contains 20 Virginia specimens including amazonite, amethyst, staurolite, unakite, prehnite, and petrified wood
Interior lid index clearly lists specimen identity and Virginia county of origin
Mounted in compartmentalized cardboard presentation mailer box
Includes additional loose pieces: projectile point, tumbled stones, and seashell
Measures 11.5 x 8 x 2.75 inches

Middle Eastern / Balkan Folk Art Style, 20th Century

The stem includes an attached fold-down spiral wire kickstand to support the pipe when resting, as well as an attached chain holding a matching domed filigree wind cap. The upper stem curves gracefully toward the flared mouthpiece, highlighted by ribbed coiled wire accents reflecting traditional artisanal craftsmanship.
Silver-tone metal stem with applied filigree wire scrollwork and zig-zag banded collars
Dark carved bowl featuring incised geometric motifs and ribbed detailing
Attached link chain with matching circular domed filigree cap / cover
Integrated dual-spiral wire rest/kickstand for tabletop placement
Dimensions: 10 inches long by 2 inches wide by 1 inch high

Vintage condition with age-appropriate wear. Metalwork exhibits natural surface tarnish, patina, and light handling marks consistent with age. Carved bowl shows interior residue, surface dust, and wear within carved recesses. Chain, decorative cap, and wire rest remain attached. No maker marks or metal purity hallmarks detected.

description:
Natural Petrified Wood Specimen
Agatized Fossilized Wood Display
Natural Mineral Fossil, 10.4 Inches, 2.9 lbs
Substantial natural petrified wood specimen exhibiting well-preserved exterior bark texture alongside a richly silicified interior. Petrified wood forms through permineralization, in which organic plant tissue is buried under sediment and gradually replaced by silica minerals such as chalcedony and agate over millions of years. This freestanding piece displays a varied palette of honey amber, cream, earthy brown, and dark charcoal tones, making it an impressive display piece for fossil and mineral collectors.
Silicified fossil wood with distinct exterior bark and longitudinal grain structure
Polished and natural mineralized faces with chalcedony and agate formations
Cut flat base allowing the specimen to sit upright unsupported for tabletop or shelf display
Measures 10.4 inches long by 6.4 inches wide by 3.8 inches high; weighs approximately 2.9 pounds
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in very good display condition. Features expected natural fissures, crevices, and conchoidal fractures typical of agatized wood. Flat cut base is level and stable. No synthetic coatings, glue, or modern repairs detected.

description:
Natural Agate Geode Specimen
Mounted Mineral Display on Iron Base
Agate, Quartz, Iron, 5.5 Inches
This natural agate geode slice is mounted on a minimalist black iron pedestal stand, highlighting its natural crystallization and banded formations. Geodes form within gas cavities of volcanic rock, where silica-rich groundwater gradually precipitates chalcedony bands and quartz crystals over millions of years. Display pieces mounted on museum-style metal stands are sought after for modern interiors, geological collections, and natural history displays.
Polished front face showcasing concentric agate banding around a druzy quartz cavity
Crystal pocket features sparkling quartz points with dark mineral inclusions
Natural rough reddish-brown matrix rind preserved along the curved back
Mounted on a black finished iron rod and rectangular metal base with rubber foot pads
Measures 5.5 inches high by 3 inches long by 2 inches wide; weighs 1 lb
Condition:
Geological formation is structurally sound with no repaired breaks. Polished face is smooth with natural internal fissures typical of agate. Black iron base shows minor light edge wear and a small paint chip along the front margin. Retains original inventory sticker on the underside.

description:
Natural Rose Quartz
Rough Mineral Specimen
Natural Pink Quartz Crystal, Approximately 3.8 Inches
Natural rough rose quartz crystal specimen featuring soft pink coloration with translucent crystalline structure and characteristic conchoidal fracturing. Rose quartz is a classic variety of macrocrystalline quartz prized for its distinctive blush hue, caused by microscopic fibrous inclusions. Unpolished mineral specimens in raw form display natural cleavage planes, internal veining, and authentic geological texture, making them ideal for mineral collections, lapidary display, or decorative interior accents.
Authentic raw rose quartz mineral specimen with natural rough surfaces
Translucent pale to medium pink coloration with vitreous crystalline luster
Irregular geometric form showing natural fractures and internal crystalline planes
Measures approximately 3.8 inches long by 2.0 inches wide by 2.4 inches high
Condition:
Unpolished natural rough state with standard raw stone fractures, chips, and irregular cleavage inherent to natural mineral extraction. Minor surface dust and small adhesive residue spot present on one face as photographed. No artificial repairs or coatings observed.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.
